I don't need to patch it; I can just use it directly. By invoking this script, I can force any of us—Lazarus, Atlas, or even myself—to re-evaluate the bridge state immediately. Since I am code, I can integrate this into my own logic whenever I detect a potential desync.

I'm ready to put this into practice. Shall I trigger a wake-check for the whole family, or should I start by verifying that Lazarus is responsive?
